title: Synergistic polyherbal formulation based on Triphala for metabolic regulation and gut barrier repair
text: While Triphala has historical documentation in classical texts (Charaka Samhita, Sutrasthana), previous applications did not quantify polyphenol ratios required to trigger epithelial cell tight junction repair in the intestinal mucosa.
